scope: Phase V1 pure-Lisp random freight in the base composition

random.invalid_domain: existing arithmetic error path; no new native status or string

random-seed.reproducibility: equal explicit seeds recreate byteidentical 55-slot state and output sequence

generator.state: 55 fixnums plus one ring cursor, held only in canonical Lisp symbol values
generator.modular_add: branch before addition so no signed-15-bit intermediate overflows
generator.range_mapping: rejection sampling; accept through 16383 - (16384 mod n), then mod n

seeding.explicit: random-seed is authoritative for tests, games, replays and debugging
seeding.lazy_default: the first random call samples VIC raster $D012, CIA1 timer A low $DC04, CIA2 timer A low $DD04 and SID voice-3 noise $D41B through existing peek
seeding.input_timing: the lazy call time naturally includes user/key timing in the two free-running timers; no key is consumed and no second input queue truth is introduced

required_proofs: negative and normalized equivalent seeds agree
a non-divisor range exercises rejection sampling
zero and non-number arguments fail through the existing arithmetic path
no native, resident, overlay or require dependency is introduced
claim_limit: Host-first contract and bytecode execution until the final bundled Phase-I/Phase-V/K2 hardware session.
